id.description: The document's own id, like FR-001; checked against the registry's prefix of the field kind names.

links.description: The ids this document links to, as its fields' values name them.

title: Madarch product document fields
description: The generic fields a product's Markdown document may carry for madarch to link it and place it: id, kind, status, links. A field this madarch does not know is ignored. The kinds themselves (and with them the field's meaning of status) are the registry's data.
